preconditions.description: The number of months for which Levian must account is between 2 and 500,000.
The number of incomes in the first half is between 1 and n/2, inclusive.
The incomes in the first half are integers between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
The income in the last month is an integer between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (indicating no such k exists) or a positive integer k that satisfies the conditions.
